# Resources {#sec-resources}

## Scientific poster design {#sec-posterdesign}

- [Useful quick tips for poster visual design by bioRender](https://www.biorender.com/blog/top-5-tips-for-designing-a-scientific-poster) - a free starting point for a commercial service. 
- [Blog post by Colin Purrington](https://colinpurrington.com/tips/poster-design/). This is the ultimate guide to scientific poster design and content definition, with a comprehensive list of dos and don'ts. 
- [A scientific article](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clnesp.2024.06.056) describing the zones of highest visual attention on a poster and suggesting an outline of sections that aligns with this

## Seminal papers {#sec-seminal-papers}

The following is a list of seminal papers in the fields relevant to this course, spanning disciplines from terrestrial ecology, land-climate interactions, carbon cycle science, to ecosystem science. Most of them are included as references in the [LES Book](https://geco-bern.github.io/les/).

### Models and Earth-system feedbacks

| In LES Book | Paper |
|---|---|
| Yes | [@sitch2003lpj], [“Evaluation of ecosystem dynamics, plant geography and terrestrial carbon cycling in the LPJ dynamic global vegetation model”](https://doi.org/10.1046/j.1365-2486.2003.00569.x) |
| Yes | [@friedlingstein2006c4mip], [“Climate--Carbon Cycle Feedback Analysis: Results from the C4MIP Model Intercomparison”](https://doi.org/10.1175/JCLI3800.1) |
| Yes | [@arneth2010feedbacks], [“Terrestrial biogeochemical feedbacks in the climate system”](https://doi.org/10.1038/ngeo905) |
| Yes | [@stocker2013multighg], [“Multiple greenhouse-gas feedbacks from the land biosphere under future climate change scenarios”](https://doi.org/10.1038/nclimate1864) |
|  | [@jones2016negative], [“Simulating the Earth system response to negative emissions”](https://doi.org/10.1088/1748-9326/11/9/095012) |
